description: This file defines the CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator class which implements ICatalogItemService, providing cached access to catalog items with local storage management and logging.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class implementing ICatalogItemService with caching logic using local storage and logging.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, utilizing cached data if valid.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves all catalog items, utilizing cached data if valid.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Fetches a catalog item by its ID from the cached list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item and refreshes the local storage cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Updates an existing catalog item and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID and updates the cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Internal method to refresh the cached list of items in local storage.
